program.section_heading: Child and Adolescent Development Associate in Arts for Transfer
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to evaluate theories, concepts, developmental processes, and empirical approaches in the scientific study of child and adolescent development from diverse perspectives across the domains of physical, cognitive, language, emotional, and social development.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to develop evidence-based strategies for children and families relevant to a culturally pluralistic and linguistically diverse society.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze biological, psychological, and environmental influences used to study child and adolescent development.
careers: Child and Adolescent care and education

blocks.name: List A: Select three courses from at least 2 groups.

notes: Codes are written as the eLumen page prints them, without a space (e.g., CHDVB21 = CHDV B21 on the closed list); all match closed-list courses.
The Core Courses printed total (10-10.5) includes the nested Statistics Course block; the two directly listed core courses total 6 units.
Statistics Course block: catalog says 'Complete the following number of credits: 4-4.5', i.e., effectively one of STAT C1000, STAT C1000E, or PSYC B5.

List A is printed with four sub-groups: Group 1 (CHDV B42, ANTH B2, SOCI B1; 0-3 units, i.e., at most one), Group 2 (BIOL B11; total 4, printed as 'Complete all of the following' though it is optional within List A), Group 3 (PSYC B40, MEDS B35; 0-3 units, at most one), Group 4 (CHDV B20, B36, B22, B32, B49; a maximum of two may be selected, 0-6 units). Students choose three courses from at least 2 groups. Recorded as one choose_courses block of 3; reviewer may wish to verify the group constraints.
Each outcome is printed with the lead-in phrase 'Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to' embedded in the outcome itself; copied as printed.

Careers taken from the program description ('Human Services, Health, and Education fields; including... Child and Adolescent care and education, special education, child and adolescent health and a variety of youth related social service careers').
The URL slug references fall-2025 although the catalog is labeled 2026-2027.
